The Zendesk twin simulates only its seeded ticket: POST /api/v2/tickets(.json) and GET /api/v2/tickets?external_id are not simulated. Covered by local tests.
Every comment on the Zendesk twin is authored by the API user, so a requester reply can't be simulated; the contract passes the choice as the ticket-field value instead. Covered by local tests.
Twin payment intents are stamped with the current time and can't be backdated, so the 31-90 day tier is unreachable. Covered by local tests.
GET /v1/customers/{id}/balance_transactions/{id} returns resource_missing on the twin for a transaction it just created.
The Square twin's gift cards report no balance_money after activation, so the read-back is unverifiable.
Zendesk's notification email is not simulated by the twin; the runtime's part (a public comment) is proven by the checks above.
